cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded a tissue into a square like you. Nice and composed. Being laid off together doesn't make your day any easier; take the box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was wrapping my chewing gum. You're wiping your eyes on your sleeve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep things tidy, then. I'm saving the soft tissues for you. Tell me what worries you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You. Your hands are shaking; you can't get the box open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take the whole box. I'll make you tea as soon as I can hold the kettle.
